marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The latest dram series from SBS takes its inspiration from reality TV shoes, and giving them that unique Korean Twist. Young Hun (Ko Soo) is a handsome young lad, but barely has a penny to his name. He works as a delivery boy for a small soup shop - hardly very glamorous. But it is for this very reason that he is approached by the producers of a new reality TV show. Young HUn must pretend to be a millionaire, whilst a gaggle of rabid, superficial, money-hungry beeauties battle it out in order to win his hand in marriage. Once his chosen bride has been selected, Young Hun must then reveal to them that he is in fact penniless, and if the girl still agrees to marry him, she will be showered with prizes.
